statement: One claim revision can point to an exact location in one representation without making page/article/item universal claim fields.
A claim may not cite only a civic document label when exact representation context is available.
Acquisition observations distinguish target/time/outcome from artifact bytes.
Repeated identical bytes may reuse artifact storage while preserving a new observation.
A later 404 or absence may not delete or negate prior evidence.
Unknown document typing remains ingestible and searchable when generic extraction works.
A specialized parser facing unexpected structure may not guess plausible semantic units.
One artifact/representation may support more than one CivicDocument identity without duplicating bytes.
DocumentPart or collection structure is introduced only if semantic independence/citation requires it.
A spreadsheet locator identifies sheet/table/range or row/header context plus observed values under a typed locator contract.
Machine-only claims are valid searchable records in supervised mode.
One operator action may apply deterministic per-record review decisions to many exact claim revisions.
Batch UX may not imply one synthetic approval that hides individual claim outcomes.
The exact source string for an entity mention survives independently from any resolved Entity.
Unresolved entity mentions remain legitimate data.
Architecture must decide whether EntityMention is a core record or an equivalent provenance-preserving structure before SQL.
Equal person names may not merge identities without independent evidence.
Candidate resolution can remain unresolved or machine-suggested pending review.
Stable local entity identity survives changing observed names.
Merge/split reconciliation preserves history rather than silently rewriting old claim anchors.
The minimal persistent merge/split mechanism must be chosen before schema freeze.
ClaimRelation endpoints bind exact claim revisions.
A material claim correction does not silently retarget an existing relation.
Machine-only relation candidates preserve origin and inspectable basis/rationale.
Many claims can share one Entity/Tag anchor without pairwise claim edges.
Transitive relations discovered during traversal may not be materialized as canonical edges without independent basis.
Recursive relation queries are bounded by depth/result policy.
EvidenceLink challenges and ClaimRelation contradicts remain different semantic contracts.
Conflicting sourced claims can coexist without ActaKit selecting a universal truth.
When role/time/amount belongs to a relationship itself the model has a promotion path beyond a simple ClaimRelation.
Rich association attributes may not be hidden in arbitrary generic edge JSON by default.
The minimal rich-association/event contract must be decided or explicitly deferred with a migration-safe boundary before SQL.
Hilo/Episode can be implemented outside core using the same read model as a structurally different output.
Output code may not silently mutate canonical civic records.
A complete backup names both canonical database and evidence archive and verifies checksums/consistency on restore.
Transfer packaging can borrow BagIt-like manifests without changing the internal domain model.
Public/redacted derivatives remain distinct from custody originals.
Lawful deletion/purge requires an explicit policy boundary before claiming immutable custody.
Repeated identical captures retain distinct logical Artifact identities while physical bytes may deduplicate through one ArchiveObject.
A source-backed ClaimRelation revision can point to exact source evidence independently from its endpoint ClaimRevisions.
The first schema contains a concrete typed RoleAssignment because the fixture already proves role and validity interval belong to the relationship itself.
A SQL DELETE or ordinary FTS row removal alone may not be reported as completed content purge.
A purge freezes an exact inspectable target manifest before execution and expands any canonical derivative that still retains prohibited material.
Purge reporting distinguishes current ActaKit authority from retained backups or storage outside the declared erasure boundary.
Shared physical bytes cannot be claimed erased while an in-scope retained Artifact still lawfully references the same ArchiveObject.
ClaimRelation traversal distinguishes deduplicated node reachability from edge/path enumeration so parallel direct relations remain inspectable without multiplying reachability results.
When an Acquisition records a source locator the locator must belong to the same Source identity recorded by that Acquisition.
A retained Representation belongs to one Artifact custody chain and a parent Representation cannot silently come from a different Artifact.
A mention-derived ClaimEntityLink records the exact accepted MentionResolutionRevision that resolved that mention to that Entity.
A later mention-resolution correction or entity split cannot leave a superseded ClaimEntityLink indistinguishable from the current anchor.
EntityReconciliation distinguishes candidate operative and rejected lineage and preserves attributable review instead of letting every recorded merge/split affect current retrieval.
A wrong machine Tag anchor can be rejected/corrected without deleting its historical assignment or forcing a new ClaimRevision.
A persisted machine/rule semantic output retains attributable ProcessRun identity rather than origin_kind alone.
Promoting or correcting an EntityReconciliation preserves the prior candidate/event through explicit supersession rather than mutating its lifecycle in place.
Correcting title issuer date language or visibility preserves stable CivicDocument identity and prior metadata through a new CivicDocumentRevision.
Relation-type directionality is explicit: symmetric contradictions/same-matter are retrievable from either endpoint while directed relations are not silently reversed or duplicated.
